preconditions.name: hard_oracle_clears_floor
preconditions.description: A greedy nearest-resource ORACLE clears COMPETENCE_RESOURCE_FLOOR resources/episode on the HARD env (724/728 convention). Same statistic as the load-bearing DV. Below => floor not achievable on hard => substrate_not_ready_requeue, NEVER a transfer verdict.
preconditions.control: greedy nearest-resource oracle, HARD env, same seed, no agent

preconditions.name: easy_oracle_clears_floor
preconditions.description: A greedy nearest-resource ORACLE clears the floor on the EASY (Stage-A) env, proving the Stage-A floor is achievable. Same statistic as the DV. Below => easy env too sparse => substrate_not_ready_requeue.
preconditions.control: greedy nearest-resource oracle, EASY env, same seed, no agent

preconditions.name: curriculum_premise_agent_forages_easy
preconditions.description: LOAD-BEARING PREMISE. At least one CURRICULUM arm must forage the EASY env >= floor on a majority (min_seeds) of seeds AFTER Stage-A -- i.e. the all-ON stack CAN forage when the env is easy. Measured as the per-seed count of Stage-A easy foraging >= floor (SAME per-seed-supra-floor statistic the load-bearing HARD criterion routes on), so met matches the indexer recompute. If NO curriculum arm forages even the easy env, the curriculum has no foundation to transfer => substrate_not_ready_requeue, NEVER a transfer-ceiling verdict (this is the guard the 732a learner-adequacy stream warns about).
preconditions.control: max over curriculum arms of the count of seeds with Stage-A easy mean_resources/ep >= floor; met when that count >= min_seeds

preconditions.name: control_reproduces_incompetence
preconditions.description: The flat-hard control A0 (matched 300ep budget) must forage BELOW the floor on a majority of seeds -- i.e. the flat-RL incompetence must reproduce -- for curriculum-vs-flat to be meaningful. If A0 already clears the hard floor the premise is not reproduced => substrate_not_ready_requeue.
preconditions.control: A0 flat-hard mean_resources/ep vs floor (majority of seeds)

preconditions.name: sufficient_p2_episodes_all_cells
preconditions.description: Every completed cell must log >= MIN_P2_EPISODES HARD P2 eval episodes so mean_resources_per_episode is estimable. Below => substrate_not_ready_requeue.
preconditions.control: min completed HARD P2 episodes across all cells
